question: For the customer who made a transaction of exactly 634.8 on '2012-08-25', compute their year-over-year consumption growth rate from 2012 to 2013. Also, identify which year—2012 or 2013—had higher total gas consumption among all customers paying in CZK.

    SELECT XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE XCL_011 = '2012-08-25' AND XCL_018 = 634.8
),
customer_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013', ym.XCL_021, 0)) - SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012', ym.XCL_021, 0)) AS REAL) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012', ym.XCL_021, 0)), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE ym.XCL_019 = (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customer)
),
czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012', y.XCL_021, 0)) AS total_2012,
        SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013', y.XCL_021, 0)) AS total_2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    INNER JOIN customers c ON y.XCL_019 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
)
SELECT 
    cg.yoy_growth_rate,
    CASE 
        WHEN cc.total_2012 > cc.total_2013 THEN '2012'
        ELSE '2013'
    END AS higher_consumption_year
FROM customer_growth cg
CROSS JOIN czk_consumption cc;

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE XCL_011 = '2012-08-25' AND XCL_018 = 634.8
),
customer_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013', ym.XCL_021, 0)) - SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012', ym.XCL_021, 0)) AS REAL) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012', ym.XCL_021, 0)), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE ym.XCL_019 = (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customer)
),
czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012', y.XCL_021, 0)) AS total_2012,
        SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013', y.XCL_021, 0)) AS total_2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    INNER JOIN customers c ON y.XCL_019 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
)
SELECT 
    cg.yoy_growth_rate,
    CASE 
        WHEN cc.total_2012 > cc.total_2013 THEN '2012'
        ELSE '2013'
    END AS higher_consumption_year
FROM customer_growth cg
CROSS JOIN czk_consumption cc;

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.XCL_018 = 634.8
      AND t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-25'
),
customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) AS year,
        SUM(t.XCL_017) AS total_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.XCL_013 IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customer)
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY t.XCL_013, strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011)
),
customer_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.customer_id,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN cc.year = '2013' THEN cc.total_consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN cc.year = '2012' THEN cc.total_consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cc.year = '2012' THEN cc.total_consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id
),
all_czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) AS year,
        SUM(t.XCL_017) AS total_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011)
),
higher_year AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) > 
                 MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) THEN '2012'
            ELSE '2013'
        END AS higher_consumption_year
    FROM all_czk_consumption
)
SELECT 
    cg.yoy_growth_rate,
    hy.higher_consumption_year
FROM customer_growth cg
CROSS JOIN higher_year hy
